messages:
jamie_devex: quick fyi, i'm kicking off a small client-side shim experiment to ease routing/quota telemetry migration. want platform + eng + product alignment before we widen it.
kevin_platform: can you sketch expected behavior? fallback-only or will we start emitting new route hints?
maria_eng: both. SDKs will accept legacy route-hint and new route-meta forms, normalize casing, and optionally emit an inferred x-rw-route-meta when the client can infer the route from call metadata. opt-in only.
kevin_platform: sample header shape we'd accept/emit: 
```
x-redwood-route-meta: {"route_id":"billing-prod","quota":"team-billing"}
```
Server should parse case-insensitively.
jamie_devex: rollout proposal: SDK opt-in flag `shim_route_meta=true` shipped as patch; server accepts legacy + new keys; console offers a migration preview tile; rollout: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% across ~48h with rollback triggers.
sara_product: console copy suggestion: "Opt into client shim to migrate routing telemetry. Preview attribution changes before enabling org-wide."
olivia_sre: SRE watchlist: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, and quota attribution drift. Pager if 5xx increases >5% or latency regression >10%.
maria_eng: small snag: older Node HTTP libs lower-case headers, our TS SDK sometimes emitted Camel-Case. we'll normalize SDK emission to lowercase and make server robust. python's requests preserves case but proxies may change it. server-side normalization is more robust.
deploy-bot: [deploy] header-normalizer v1.0 deployed to staging 1:23Z :rocket:
kevin_platform: i'll open a PR to normalize incoming header keys to lowercase before JSON parse. tests included.
maria_eng: SDK plan: py/ts/go add opt-in flag, an env var `RW_DISABLE_ROUTE_SHIM=1` for emergency opt-out, emit metric `client.shim.route_meta.enabled` with semver, and tag traces with shim flag. unit tests to simulate proxy-lowercasing.
jamie_devex: UX: console should have a preview modal that samples ~1k requests and shows before/after attribution distribution + estimated quota cost delta. also add a small admin banner at 25%/100% milestones.
sara_product: agree, add staged email + banner when org hits 25% canary and when fully enabled. include link to preview modal and rollback steps.
olivia_sre: add trace-span annotation when server falls back to legacy header parsing so we can find mismatches. also add a migration metric `migration.attribution.delta` for dashboards.
maria_eng: metrics + spans added in local branch. will push SDK patches tomorrow morning. server PR lands midday. console tile prototype EOD.
kevin_platform: schedule: wait 24h after server change before starting canary to avoid overlapping infra churn. canaries: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with checks between stages.
jamie_devex: rollback criteria suggestion: >=1% traffic error spike OR quota attribution delta >3% at 25% OR any SE-reported regressions. agree?
olivia_sre: +1
kevin_platform: +1
maria_eng: +1
sara_product: +1
jamie_devex: action list: kevin: server PR + deploy plan; maria: SDK opt-in + metrics + releases; sara: console copy + preview modal mock; olivia: dashboards + pager rules; jamie: short RFC + changelog blurb. keep updates here during rollout only. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: rollout ticket created: RTE-2026-047, canary scheduled pending staging sign-off.
